seo.title: Factors of 16 Math Clicker - Square Number Divisors
seo.metaDescription: Click all factors of 16 on a 100-number grid. Discover why square numbers have an odd number of factors in this math fluency challenge.
seo.intro: Because 16 is a perfect square (4 x 4 = 16), it possesses an odd count of factors: 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16. The repeated factor pair 4 x 4 means 4 is counted only once. In this speed game, students identify the 5 factors of 16 scattered across the 100-tile board, reinforcing power-of-two relationships and square number divisors.
seo.howToPlay: Locate and click the 5 factors of 16. Correct factors turn green with a checkmark. Incorrect clicks flash red and penalize 2 seconds from the timer. Locate all 5 factors before time expires.
seo.teacherNotes: Explain why square numbers always have an odd total number of factors because the middle factor pairs with itself.

faq.q: What are all the factors of 16?
Why does 16 have an odd number of factors?
faq.a: Because 16 is a square number (4 x 4), the factor 4 pairs with itself rather than a different number.
